gloss: designer; architect; engineer who designs something

definitions.explanation: A person who creates the plans or blueprints for something to be built or made — a building, machine, system, or software. Used for architects, mechanical engineers, software architects, and similar roles.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設計者|せっけいしゃ}。
{設計者|せっけいしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I had a chance to speak directly with the designer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図面|ずめん}→図面：12023_zumen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{設計者|せっけいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The drawing lists the designer's name and the date.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{設計者|せっけいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}がけた→手がける：12753_tegakeru⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧{開館|かいかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A museum designed by a famous architect opens this month.

notes:
The agent noun from ⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧ (design) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Covers a wide range of design fields from architecture to engineering to software.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設計者|せっけいしゃ}: the designer of ~
- {設計者|せっけいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意図|いと}→意図：12625_ito⟧: the designer's intent
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設計者|せっけいしゃ}: the architect of the building
- ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設計者|せっけいしゃ}: the designer of the machine
- {設計者|せっけいしゃ}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of designers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{建築家|けんちくか}→建築家：06082_kenchikuka⟧: architect — specifically a professional architect of buildings
- ⟦デザイナー→デザイナー：05061_dezainaa⟧: designer — a borrowing; common in fashion, graphic design, and product design contexts
- ⟦{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}→技術者：17049_gijutsusha⟧: engineer; technician — broader, refers to anyone with technical expertise
- {考案者|こうあんしゃ}: devisor; person who came up with an idea — emphasizes the conceptual invention rather than detailed design work

USAGE:
{設計者|せっけいしゃ} is the standard technical and legal term for whoever created the design of something. In everyday conversation about buildings, ⟦{建築家|けんちくか}→建築家：06082_kenchikuka⟧ is more common; for clothing or web pages, ⟦デザイナー→デザイナー：05061_dezainaa⟧ is typical. {設計者|せっけいしゃ} shines in engineering contexts and on official documents.
